en: Black‑and‑white riverfront view of a European city, showing a wide stone staircase lined with trees descending to quays with several steamships moored along the river. On the right stands a large historicist building with a tall tower and dome. In the background a multi‑arch stone bridge spans the river toward a densely built cityscape and low hills. Pedestrians stroll along the promenade and near the steps. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image.
